name: SaaSquatch Opportunity Intelligence
postCreateCommand: cd backend && mvn -q test && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build

postAttachCommand.backend: bash -lc 'if ! curl -sf http://localhost:8080/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd backend && nohup mvn -q spring-boot:run >/tmp/saasquatch-backend.log 2>&1 &) ; fi'
postAttachCommand.frontend: bash -lc 'if ! curl -sf http://localhost:5173 >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd frontend && nohup npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/saasquatch-frontend.log 2>&1 &) ; fi'
